RESELLER AGREEMENT

This Reseller Agreement is between Lumen Analytics, Inc. ("Vendor") and Northgate Systems LLC ("Reseller").

1. Appointment. Vendor appoints Reseller as a non-exclusive reseller of the products in the United States.

2. Pricing. Reseller will buy the products at a 30% discount from list price and sets its own resale prices.

3. End Users. Reseller will pass through the end user terms of Vendor to each customer.

4. Trademarks. Reseller may use the trademarks of Vendor only to market the products.
